$comment: The one audience the repository cannot derive from anything else.
Every other id an ID token can carry is already declared somewhere
authoritative, and re-listing it here would make this file a second source
of truth — the defect android_signing_test.dart already forbids in as many
words. So this declares the Apple web Services ID and nothing else:
Apple, the two iOS apps -> PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER in the Xcode project
Apple, the web          -> here, because it exists only in Apple's portal
to the union of those three on every push.

appleWebServicesId.what: the Sign in with Apple Services ID used by the web surface
appleWebServicesId.servedAs: NEXT_PUBLIC_APPLE_CLIENT_ID, set in Vercel and inlined at build
$note: Unlike a bundle id this is a name somebody chose, so nothing about the
app binaries implies it. It was already live and allowlisted when this
file was written — measured against the real secret on 2026-08-23, which
corrected a design that had assumed it did not exist yet.
